full_prompt_en: A square black and white fashion photograph frames a woman's face closely beneath an enormous pale fur hat. The hat fills almost the entire upper half of the image, its fluffy fibers spreading toward the left and right edges and catching bright silver light along the crest. Beneath that soft mass, her dark fringe and shadowed eyes emerge from a deep black area at the left center. Her face turns slightly toward the viewer, with one cheek, the bridge of her nose, and softly parted lips modeled in luminous gray. A loose dark strand of hair curves over the cheek on the right. More pale fur rises from the lower right corner and wraps across her shoulder, nearly meeting the hat to enclose the face between two textured white forms. The left lower quadrant remains almost entirely black, giving the delicate facial planes room to stand out. The crop is close enough that clothing and surroundings disappear, leaving only the contrast of skin, dark hair, and dense fur. Directional studio light from the upper right skims the individual fibers and gives the cheek a smooth gradient, while the eyes remain partly veiled by shadow. Fine film-like grain softens the transitions without obscuring the hat's tactile detail. A thin off-white border encloses the image, preserving the feel of a printed editorial photograph. The whole composition is dramatic and restrained, built from a few large tonal masses and the tension between sharp facial attention and feathery texture.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白时装摄影作品把女子的脸紧紧框在一顶巨大浅色蓬松皮草帽下。帽子几乎填满画面上半部，松软纤维向左右边缘散开，顶端接住亮银色光线。在柔软体块之下，她的深色刘海和阴影中的眼睛从左中部的浓黑区域浮现。脸微微转向观者，一侧面颊、鼻梁和轻轻张开的双唇由发亮的灰色塑出。右侧一缕深发弯曲地掠过脸颊。更多浅色皮草从右下角升起，包住她的肩部，几乎与帽子相接，使脸被两团有纹理的白色形体围住。左下象限几乎全黑，让细致的面部色阶突出。裁切距离很近，衣服和环境都消失，只留下皮肤、深发与密集皮草的对比。从右上方来的定向影棚光掠过单根纤维，赋予面颊平滑渐变，而眼睛仍部分藏在阴影里。细微胶片般颗粒柔化过渡，却不遮没帽子可触的细节。细窄的灰白边框围住画面，保留印刷时装照片的气息。整体构图戏剧性而克制，由少数大块明暗体量和锐利面部注意力与羽毛般肌理之间的张力建成。
style_prompt_en: Black and white editorial photography builds impact from a small number of large tonal masses: luminous silver white, velvety charcoal, and almost absolute black. Close cropping compresses the scene and lets one richly textured area dominate the frame, while a smaller smooth region provides a calm focal interval. Directional studio lighting grazes fine fibers and raised surfaces, separating individual strands from the bright whole. Shadow falls heavily across one side, allowing selected planes to emerge through gradual gray modeling rather than uniform fill. Contrast is high at the border of light and dark yet soft within the pale area, where fine grain and diffuse highlights retain tactile depth. A few narrow curved lines interrupt broad fields without making the composition busy. The image feels luxurious and intimate, with precise tonal control and a restrained printed photographic finish. Its visual rhythm moves from feathery brightness through a quiet midtone center into deep, enveloping darkness.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白编辑摄影由少数大明暗体块建立冲击：发亮银白、天鹅绒般炭灰和近乎绝对的黑。近距离裁切压缩场景，让一块肌理丰厚的区域主导画面，较小的平滑区域则提供安静的视觉间歇。定向影棚光擦过细纤维和凸起表面，把一根根线状纹理从明亮整体中分离。阴影重重落在一侧，让选定的面通过渐变灰阶而非均匀补光浮现。明暗边界对比强烈，浅色区域内部却柔和，细颗粒与散射高光保留可触纵深。几条窄曲线打断大色域，但不让构图繁忙。影像奢华而亲密，明暗控制精确，带克制的印刷摄影质感。视觉节奏由羽毛般亮部移向安静中间调，再进入包围性的深黑。
theme_en: Close black and white fashion portrait with a pale fur hat
theme_zh: 佩戴浅色蓬松皮草帽的近景黑白时装肖像
name: Michel Comte
